scope: Persistent local sign-out intent and pre-auth recovery gate; not remote revocation or physical-storage durability certification
behaviors: Write non-sensitive intent before explicit SDK sign-out
Confirm SDK getSession is empty and local cleanup completed before intent removal
Startup/new sign-in retries pending sign-out before new authentication
Unremoved local SDK session causes logout rejection with displayed session cleared
Confirmed server deletion retains intent if local session removal fails
Recovery failures keep startup anonymous but initialized for retry
remaining: Native process-kill verification for the new sign-out marker
If intent cannot be written, in-process state cannot prove durability after a crash
Physical disk/power-loss behavior and remote revocation under network failure unverified
Automatic SDK startup/background services before app gate require wider lifecycle audit
